about_the_game:
Final Signature is a single-player psychological horror game where you explore an abandoned hotel, search for hidden clues, and compete against other mysterious participants in a deadly game. As fear builds with each step, you’ll need to decide who to trust—and who to escape from.

Solve puzzles and navigate through dark corridors and eerie rooms. De'Manor Hotel is a place seemingly frozen in time, with its gloomy hallways and dust-covered, abandoned lounges. Once renowned for its luxury and grandeur, the hotel is now nothing more than a sinister relic filled with whispers and shadows. The damp smell and the creaking wooden floors create an unsettling sensation—as if something is always watching you from behind.

Lucas Miller, a desperate father facing financial ruin, receives a mysterious invitation on his computer: participate in a deadly game at a remote hotel to win a prize that could save his cancer-stricken daughter.
Set in the decrepit De'Manor Hotel, players must explore its haunted halls, evade enemies, uncover clues, and solve the building’s chilling mysteries. Final Signature is played from a first-person perspective and challenges players to survive, no matter the cost. But this hotel hides more than just secrets…

Once you enter, there is no way out. Everyone has a different reason for being here—but no one is truly alone.
To claim the ultimate prize, you must push your limits and uncover the hotel’s darkest secrets. As the game progresses, your perception of reality may begin to distort. And eventually, you’ll learn that trusting anyone is a mistake.

A mask. A pen. A contract signed in blood.
Everything has a price. If you want to win at De'Manor Hotel, first decide what you're willing to sacrifice.
Just one signature... and there’s no turning back.
Take your chances. But remember: some contracts can only be broken in blood.

The door creaks open—but you’ll never know what truly lies inside.
Silence is not safety. Behind some doors, there’s more than just darkness... sometimes, a pair of eyes watches from within.
Fear doesn’t always begin with a scream—it begins with silence.
Every room has a story. Every shadow belongs to someone.
Do you dare to enter?

DEVELOPER’S WARNING: Those who fear darkness, suffer from claustrophobia, or feel uneasy when alone are advised not to play this game alone. Final Signature offers an experience that only the brave can endure until the end.

Important Notice: This is a work of fiction. Names, characters, locations, and events are purely fictional or used fictitiously. Any resemblance to real events, places, or living/deceased persons is entirely coincidental.

WARNING: This game may trigger seizures in players with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460 or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 460
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 - 11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-11400 or Ryzen 5 5500 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® rtx 3050 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580 or better
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard audio device

short_description: Final Signature is a psychological horror game set in an abandoned hotel. Players must find hidden clues and compete with other participants for the grand prize. As tension rises in the dark corridors, they will face new dangers with every step.
